speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Criminal court part two
is now in session.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And semi-mystical,
Harold T. Stone presiding.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I guess they're used to you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - The thrill is gone, yes, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Now all we need are the attorneys.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, where are Dan and Billie?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
They had to run to city hall.
They're both up for an appointment...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...with the new commission
on crime and youthful offenders.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Then maybe they're stuck in traffic.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I know, I know, I'm late.
I am terribly sorry, forgive me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I am ashamed, I beg your apology...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and I promise the court
that it will never happen again.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Can you believe his nerve,
keeping us waiting like this?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I think I demonstrated a lot of knowledge
about crime problems and kids.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, guys, let me down.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I know, and I tried to tell them.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Doesn't it do your heart good
to see such an outpouring of affection?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What a lovely gang of lads, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And surprisingly affordable too, I'll bet.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, they do receive a small stipend...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but it's part of a work-study program
that I established.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm teaching them
that I can buy their support.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Say, what about that first case, huh?
Bull.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Seven counts of lewd and immoral conduct,
five counts of prostitution...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...couple of counts of intent
to commit acts of prostitution.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No, sir, we have four defendants.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ... Cynthia Peters, Pattie Valentine, and my wife.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Quon Le, what the hell is this all about?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But I haven't seen him
since the wedding.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - This what they call an open relationship?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Actually, Mac is just sort of
temporarily acting in the role of spouse.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That's all we did,
and we got busted for it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Mac and Quon Le are legally married.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It's a formality,
so she can stay in the country.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Say, when did I lose control?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
- Right off the bat, huh?
Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
As far as I can tell, Quon Le just happened
to be in the wrong place at the wrong time.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I had no place to stay...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...so my new American friends
let me be their roommate.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
According to this report, they let
the entire merchant fleet be their roommate.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
My clients have indicated
they'd be willing to plead no contest...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...on the first three charges
provided prosecution drops the rest.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Correction,
Quon Le Duc is found not guilty...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Now, as for Tawny and the Tawnettes here,
let's make it 10 days.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yeah, go talk to her. We'll have a short...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: So how was it with somebody else?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Quon Le, how'd you wind up
with those bimbos?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
When we got married, I thought you had
an apartment on the Lower East Side.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I did, but I had to move
after the men broke in.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Due to an erroneous setting while...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Heating a can of Cheez Whiz.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I was trying to make fondue.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The Ginsu knives,
my Civil War chess set...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...my special record albums
not available in any store.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Why don't I give you money,
help you back on your feet?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You don't have to do that.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Come on, you obviously got bills and stuff.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Okay, then don't be embarrassed,
how much do you need?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What do you think of the new choppers?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I wouldn't delude myself if I were you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You can't be as qualified as I am.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Integrity is what I'm talking about.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It's about the appointment
on the commission.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Yes, sir. They've narrowed it down
to three finalists.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Me, her,
and some joker from the Bronx.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, congratulations.
That's quite an honor, isn't it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
To have two out of the three chosen
from our truck stop on the road to justice.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Yes, indeed, sir,
and I am sure that it is a...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
A reflection on the brilliant leadership
you provide here at court.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I would be honored
if you could see your way clear...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'd be glad to write a letter
of recommendation for both of you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You see, it has to be one or the other.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Otherwise, it's gonna look like a form letter,
and it won't carry any weight with them.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
As I see it,
this is an either-or situation.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And may the best man win.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You guys are putting me in a tough spot.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I mean, basically, you're asking me
to choose between you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, Harry, I don't think
that should be so difficult.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The court finds the defendant guilty with a
two-day suspended sentence and a $50 fine.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And, Mr. Conway,
remember that a funeral at St. Pat's...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...is no place for a singing telegram.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Notice how effortlessly
I cornered the defendant?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Dan, the man was wearing
a chicken suit in a cathedral.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Missed the freedom-of-religion angle,
didn't you?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Your Honor,
about the letter of recommendation...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I haven't made my decision yet, Dan.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Take your time. Do not rush into this.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm sure your decision will be fair and just,
per your usual standards.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, they get you processed out okay?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I even got copies of my picture.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - See, one for each of us.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'll just trim out the prisoner number.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I have to find a place to live.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, don't worry about me, I'll be fine.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Shelter, mission.
I hear the park is nice this time of year.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Look, you can't stay with me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Besides, I would never
ask such an imposition...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You don't mean it, so don't say it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I've made my decision, guys.
Come on in.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I got it. I got it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, Mac, wanna grab a bite to eat?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No, I'm even lower than scum,
I am bread mold.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: How cruel can one person be?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
There's this guy in Passaic
that took a meat cleaver...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, do you know what I just did?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I just kicked Quon Le out of here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Exactly. What did she do to deserve that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The kid doesn't have a penny
to her name...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and I just turned her loose
to the vultures in the street.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She's probably out there
getting beat up by some creep...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...who wants to steal
the caps off her teeth.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I thought you took it
a little too calmly before.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
How could you do it, Harry?
How could you give it to him?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: That man is a walking slag heap.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That may be,
but he's a well-qualified slag heap.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Whatever we happen to think
of Dan's personality...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...the fact remains
that he is a well-qualified attorney...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...who has several more years experience
at criminal cases than you...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...so taking everything into consideration,
I felt I had to give the nod to him.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And also taking everything
into consideration, Your Honor...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...I have decided to transfer
to someone else's courtroom.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
After all, there must be some place
where I rate a little higher...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...than a colleague
with the ethics of a dung beetle.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Billie, I know you're a little miffed
right now, but please don't...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
There you go again,
throwing your money around.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sorry, I only wish to know
why you tell me we should talk...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm going over my options in my mind.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
See, A, you move in with me,
and I owe $ 18,000...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...B, you don't move in with me,
and I owe $ 18,000.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I get hit by a bus, and I die...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It is not you who owes money, Mac,
it is I.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Yeah, but you see, you're my wife.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And the law says what's yours is mine,
and what's mine is yours.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I guess I didn't realize how much
until I saw you again tonight.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, let's have some lunch and talk.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I thought it was a law.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You ever see Premature Burial with Ray Milland?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I know. I saw her down at the cafeteria
digging timbers out of her fingers.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, I'm telling you, I expected her
to be disappointed by my recommendation...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but the way she reacted
was just totally off the wall.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Can I say something off the record?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: How about we go back on the record?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: She thinks you don't like her.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But my not giving her the recommendation
was nothing personal.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But she wanted you to say,
"You're doing a good job, Billie."

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She wanted you to say,
"I like the way you do things."

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We all want approval
from somebody we care about and respect.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And, Harry, she cares about you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: How did you get so smart, anyway?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I've had some rough lessons in life, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And I've used those experiences to learn,
and grow and survive.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No, those soda crackers
filled me right up.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Mac, I am very sorry
I am the cause of all your troubles.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You're not the cause of all my troubles.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Although, you've sure helped me
to forget what the others might be.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
If we actually live together
as husband and wife...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: A man named Phil told him.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Quon Le, but we'd have extra problems.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Because even though America
is the land of liberty and all that...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...some people haven't accepted the idea
of two people from different races...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, of course I can accept it,
but it's because I love you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That is the first time
you said you love me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...there's a chance it could get ugly.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...I have lived with war
ever since I was 5 years old.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
My home was destroyed,
most of my family were killed.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And I have lived with that horror
every single day of my life.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Tell me, can it get any uglier than that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I can't stand living in a messy apartment.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, not to mention, I like to watch
a lot of sports on TV.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Plus, I like three eggs scrambled
every day for breakfast.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You have them any way you like.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I don't know how to cook.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, what the hell, Quon Le.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: If you think you can put up with me...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I can put up with you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But the first thing we gotta do
when we get home...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...is to sit down and figure out exactly
what that 18,000 bucks went for.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Okay, I know you're not too thrilled
with me right now...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but I'd like to show you
what I have here in my robe.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Sort of a letter of recommendation.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Thought you could take it with you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
"She's got a good head on her shoulders,
but more important, she's got a good heart.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She's earned the respect of her peers
and the affection of friends.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She's a sworn enemy of the smug,
and the callous, and the corrupt.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Because when it comes
to other human beings, she's a lover...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...in the finest sense of the word.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
In short, the world is a better place
because Billie Young is in it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Sincerely yours, Judge Harold T. Stone.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I don't know how to thank you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You could start by withdrawing
your application for transfer.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I was afraid they'd accept it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, I'll fix you a Bartini.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Pick a card, any card. Aha!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Is it just my imagination,
or are you a little less than chipper?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I just found out it's all over.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
They gave my spot on the commission
to the other guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He said the board chairman
thought you were too young...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...and far too flaky to be taken seriously.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, we do what we can.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You know, I just can't believe they gave it
to that joker from the Bronx.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm the joker from the Bronx.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You... You mean, you...?
Oh, well, Father...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I wanted to congratulate her
on a race well run.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: She's well thought of down at city hall.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Uh, heh. Well, what about me?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Oh, I heard about you too,
and believe me, I know you're going places.
